text:
Ava (Finance): FYI — invoice INV-2026-078 has a weird capacity allocation. It shows a 50k token reserved commit in eu-west on project 'search-api' but usage credited to 'realtime-ingest'. Can someone confirm if this is a bucket reallocation or metering bug?

Liam (Account Ops): checking. Did this customer ask to split commit between projects?

Priya (Customer Success): They asked for a temporary reassign during Q3 while onboarding. I thought we adjusted allocation in Dedicated > Allocations tab last month.

Jordan (Billing): grabbing lines from invoice export:
```csv
line_id,project_code,service,units,amount
3421,search-api,reserved_commit_tokens,50000,5000.00
3422,realtime-ingest,overage_tokens,12000,720.00
```
Looks like reserved tokens remained on search-api but usage shows elsewhere.

InvoiceBot: Allocation change recorded 2026-06-08 by liam.ops for customer acme-inc: reassign 25k from realtime-ingest -> search-api. (audit-id: abcd-1234)

Liam (Account Ops): I made that change but it only moved 25k; remainder should still be shared. Might be an orchestration delay.

Ava (Finance): Customer is disputing the $720 overage (small but they'd like credit). They'd also like internal reallocation to avoid future charge. How do we proceed?

Priya (Customer Success): Customer prefers a one-time credit and updated allocation. I'll confirm permission to issue credit.

Jordan (Billing): From billing side we can either issue a manual credit of $720 or reissue invoice after reallocating commits. Reissue will push timeline.

Marta (Finance Director): For <$1k and clear allocation mistake, approve one-time credit and ticket ops to change allocation. @Liam (Account Ops) please confirm you can reassign 12k to cover the overage and file a change record.

Liam (Account Ops): will reassign 12k now and ping when done. ETA 15m.

Ava (Finance): Thanks. Jordan, issue $720 credit memo referencing INV-2026-078 and tag with 'capacity-bucket-reallocation'. Priya please record customer approval.

Jordan (Billing): On it. Creating credit memo CM-2026-119. tagging internal notes. :white_check_mark:

InvoiceBot: Credit CM-2026-119 created and applied to INV-2026-078 by jordan.billing at 1975308700.

Liam (Account Ops): Allocation updated — moved 12k from realtime-ingest -> search-api. Audit link: https://internal.acme/alloc/abcd-5678

Priya (Customer Success): Confirmed with customer; they accepted credit and allocation change. Closing.

Ava (Finance): Closing thread. Leave a note for month-end recon.

Marta (Finance Director): good call. Document in backlog: FIN-ops/allocations. :thumbsup:
